## Overview

This collected Braintree page is a direct-link portal for a recipient of the link with at least one merchant account provisioned and funded by Moneris. It routes the recipient to articles tailored to nuances associated with the account and recommends bookmarking the portal because those articles are accessible only by direct links and cannot be found by searching Braintree's support website.

Treat this as a 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted navigation snapshot. It does not establish that every merchant account is provisioned or funded by Moneris, identify a region, define the route label, provide independent current Moneris or banking-partner policy, document any linked target's behavior, establish API behavior, or prove current account status or an individual funding outcome.

## Key takeaways

- The recipient condition is exact: receiving a link to this page means at least one of the recipient's merchant accounts is both provisioned and funded by Moneris. The page does not extend that condition to every merchant account.
- The page says aspects of payment processing, including accepted payment types, can vary depending on the banking partner. Braintree's generic public support articles can therefore omit important account-specific details.
- According to this snapshot, the partner bank was determined during the application process and depends mostly on when the merchant signed up with Braintree and where the business is domiciled. A merchant with multiple merchant accounts may have multiple partner banks.
- This overview identifies an account-tailored documentation route; it does not itself enumerate accepted payment types or establish the instructions, conditions, limits or outcomes of any linked article. Read the relevant target before relying on its behavior, and do not transfer details from sibling processor or regional routes.

> [!warning] Preserve the complete recipient and account condition
> Keep `at least one`, `merchant accounts`, `provisioned and funded`, and `by Moneris` together. The statement is conditioned on receipt of the link and does not establish that all accounts have that setup or that the condition remains current.

> [!warning] Navigation is not target authority
> The portal does not establish a region, current bank policy, linked-article behavior, API behavior, payment acceptance, settlement, disbursement or an individual funding outcome.

quotes.text: This page is your portal to articles that have been tailored to reflect the nuances associated with your account. It’s important to note that these articles are only accessible via direct links. You won’t be able to find them by searching our support website.
**We strongly recommend that you** [bookmark this page](http://www.computerhope.com/issues/ch000858.htm) so you can easily reference this important information in the future.

Certain aspects of payment processing (e.g. accepted payment types) can vary depending on your banking partner. As a result, our public support articles are generic and can exclude important details. The partner bank was determined during the application process; it mostly depends on when you signed up with Braintree and where your business is domiciled. If you have multiple merchant accounts, it is possible that they are associated with multiple partner banks.
If you’ve received a link to this page, it means at least one of your merchant accounts is provisioned and funded by Moneris.
